assets.name: Duolingo
assets.tagline: The free, fun, and effective way to learn a language.
assets.mission: Make language education free and available to everyone on earth, and keep it that way.
assets.vision: A world where the best education money can buy costs nothing.
assets.values: Take the user's side. Ship it. Be silly on purpose. Learning should feel like a game, not homework. If it isn't free, it isn't finished.
assets.about: We started because language classes cost money and most people don't have any. So we built the opposite: a green owl that lives in your phone, bugs you every evening, and teaches you Spanish five minutes at a time. Fourteen years later the owl is still bugging people, and that is the entire business model.
assets.founder_story: Two people who had already built one thing the internet uses every day decided the next thing should be free forever. Everyone told them free education was a charity, not a company. They shipped it anyway.
homepage: Learn a language in 5 minutes a day. Yes, five. We timed it.
Free. Actually free. Not free-trial free.
Your streak is 3 days old. Do not let it die on our watch.
product_page: Short lessons that feel like a game, because your brain shows up for games and hides from homework.
Get a wrong answer? You lose a heart, not your dignity. Try again in a minute.
Leagues, streaks, XP, gems. We stole every trick mobile games use and pointed it at Portuguese.
blog: We looked at 2 billion exercises and found that people who practise at night remember more the next morning. We have no idea why. We are looking into it.
Why the owl guilt-trips you: a short, mildly embarrassing history of our push notifications.
Everyone asks if gamification actually works. Short answer: yes, but only if you're honest about the fact that you're doing it.
social: your streak is on fire and so am I
Day 400 of Spanish. Still cannot order coffee. Still going.
The owl sees you skipping. The owl says nothing. The owl remembers.
ad: Learn Spanish or the owl gets sad. Your call.
5 minutes a day. That's less than you spent choosing something to watch.
job_post: We are looking for people who think education should be free and are annoyed that it isn't. Bring opinions. Bring them loudly.
You will ship things that millions of people use before lunch. This is fun and slightly terrifying.
support_doc: Lost your streak? Streak Freeze protects it for one day off. Here's how to equip one.
Hearts refill over time, or instantly with gems. If you run out, practise old lessons to earn them back.
case_study: A school district in Texas replaced its Spanish workbook budget with the app and reported the same test scores at zero cost.
testimonial: I have a 900 day streak and a personality disorder about it. Also I can now argue in French.
